verdict.rationale: Square documents explicit offline payment handling in its Mobile Payments SDK (square-docs-5), which stores transactions locally and forwards them once connectivity resumes, directly matching the story. However, this is scoped to the Android Mobile Payments SDK only, with no evidence of offline support for Square's core POS app, Terminal, or Tap to Pay hardware, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability. Missing for 10: offline support evidence for iOS/Terminal/POS app, first-party documentation on sync conflict handling, and independent verification of real-world offline-to-online reconciliation.
